verdict.rationale: Qodo's code review docs say each finding explains how to fix it, and that users can let Qodo apply the fix directly. Fix with Chat Agent can also remediate issues from the PR chat. The evidence does not show these fixes appear as committable suggested-diff blocks inside review comments, or that applying them is a single click. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of suggested-diff/suggestion-block rendering in PR comments, a confirmed one-click commit flow, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, review comments include committable suggested diffs I can apply with one click

citations.quote: Discuss or dismiss a finding, or let Qodo apply the fix directly.
every finding states what needs attention, why it matters, and how to fix it, ranked by severity
Use Fix with Chat Agent to remediate issues while you chat with Qodo.
